name: ixitek
description: IXITEK — international B2B networking & fiber-optics platform. Deployed as ONE Node.js Web App: ixitek-backend (Express + MySQL) serves /api/* and the built ixitek-frontend (React/Vite) from a single origin.

scripts.build: npm install --prefix ixitek-backend --no-audit --no-fund && npm install --prefix ixitek-frontend --no-audit --no-fund --include=dev && npm run build --prefix ixitek-frontend
